description: This file contains Go code implementing a 'BaseTab' structure with methods for traversing, dumping, and displaying network node data, including integration with C code via cgo. It appears to be part of a GUI application using the Fyne framework, and interacts with an underlying C-based network node data structure.

classes.name: BaseTab
classes.description: A structure representing a tab in the GUI that manages and displays network node data, with associated methods for data handling and UI updates.

methods.name: dumpNetNode
methods.description: Recursively traverses and logs the contents of a C network node structure, displaying types and values.

methods.name: children
methods.description: Returns the child nodes of a given TreeNodeID, formatted for GUI display.

methods.name: branch
methods.description: Determines if a node should be shown as a branch (expandable) in the GUI tree.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new GUI object (placeholder implementation).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the GUI object with a given TreeNodeID.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the current network node data structure.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the network node data structure.

methods.name: getCanvasObject
methods.description: Returns the current GUI object associated with the tab.

methods.name: setCanvasObject
methods.description: Sets the GUI object associated with the tab.
